notices.title: Library week
notices.content: A book exhibition and reading competition will be organised during the school week.

notices.content: The half yearly examination routine has been published. Students should collect their admit cards from the office.

notices.content: Parents are invited to meet the class teachers this Saturday between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM.
